hooks.command:
command -v gitleaks >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo 'pre-push: gitleaks not installed (brew install gitleaks) — blocking push until secrets can be verified.' >&2; exit 2; }
gitleaks git --no-banner --redact "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" >&2 || { echo 'pre-push: gitleaks flagged a potential secret above — push blocked. Remove it, or allowlist in .gitleaks.toml if it is a false positive.' >&2; exit 2; }
